queries.prompt: TRUNCATE랑 DELETE는 둘 다 테이블 비우는 건데 왜 비용이랑 rollback 규칙이 달라?
queries.reformulated_query: TRUNCATE vs DELETE row delete cost rollback transaction trigger foreign key identity reset
queries.rationale: Table data removal semantics should route to TRUNCATE vs DELETE instead of undo-space truncation, generic metadata lock, or online schema change docs.

queries.prompt: 트래픽이 갑자기 늘어서 쓰기 요청이 몰리면 DB는 어디부터 막히는지 큰 그림으로 보고 싶어
queries.reformulated_query: DB write pressure traffic spike connection pool lock WAL redo dirty page flush checkpoint IO queue replication lag
queries.rationale: Write-burst resource contention should route before single slow-query, pool-only, or replica-lag-only explanations.

queries.prompt: 읽기 쿼리가 갑자기 느려졌는데 실행 계획 문제인지 디스크 I/O 경합인지 어떻게 나눠 봐?
queries.reformulated_query: DB read latency query plan vs storage IO contention buffer pool miss page cache miss iowait queue depth
queries.rationale: Read-latency triage should route to the entrypoint before deep slow-query tuning, buffer-pool read-ahead internals, or OS counter interpretation.

queries.prompt: MSA에서 서비스마다 DB를 따로 둔다는 게 무슨 뜻이고, 다른 서비스 테이블을 join하면 왜 문제야?
queries.reformulated_query: database per service ownership shared database distributed monolith cross service table join API event read model
queries.rationale: Service data ownership should not be swallowed by broad MSA failure, intra-database denormalization, or generic consistency-boundary docs.

queries.prompt: 커스텀 어노테이션을 만들었는데 왜 아무 일도 안 일어나? @Target이랑 @Retention도 같이 알려줘
queries.reformulated_query: custom Java Spring annotation @interface Target Retention runtime reflection AOP argument resolver annotation processor
queries.rationale: Annotation definition and retention should route before custom qualifier, compile-time annotation processing, or AOP proxy internals.
